description: This file contains functions to mock and intercept browser Notification API calls during Playwright tests, capturing notifications and waiting for a specified number of notifications within a timeout.

classes.name: NotificationData
classes.description: Type alias combining notification title and options for capturing notification details.

methods.name: stubNotification
methods.description: Intercepts the Notification API in the page context to capture notifications and override permission behavior.

methods.name: waitForNotification
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for a specified number of notifications to be received within a timeout period.
